evidence: contract test PASS (45 tests); without-baseline 0.25 (utilisation inside the budget is read as proof the schedule fits, which it is not: the sum says nothing about an instant where several items are released together, and the determinism check needs the hyperperiod least common multiple, which is meaningless when the cycle times are carried as floating-point seconds rather than whole microseconds; an offset equal to its own cycle is also accepted as a late start when it is a duplicate release, the schedule is checked against the model catalogue instead of the instance paths that actually provide entry points, and a heavy one-shot is dropped from the assessment because it adds no cyclic load)
